title: Quiz: Progressive Web Apps Basics
description: Check your understanding of Progressive Web Apps Basics.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in HTML?
questions.explanation: In HTML, <!-- --> marks a comment. Block comments use -->.

questions.question: What makes a site installable as a PWA?
options: Only a mobile app store listing
questions.explanation: The three pillars Chrome requires for the install prompt.

questions.question: True or False: Service workers can serve cached pages when the network is down.
Fill in the blank: the ${manifest} file declares app name, icons, and display mode
questions.explanation: manifest.json (or link tag) describes the installable app.

questions.question: In HTML, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
